pages: Cats sit on mats and sleep about sixteen hours each day. Indoor cats should have fresh water.
Dogs chase balls and need daily walks. Adult dogs usually eat two meals per day.
Employees may work remotely on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Laptops must be locked when unattended.
The office opens at 9am and closes at 6pm. Visitors must sign in at reception.
